collection.title: Citroen C5 X 2021 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Citroen C5 X Hatchback 2021 model requires a 24" wiper blade for the drivers and a 16" on the passengers side with a Slim Push Button arm attachment. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle.
